executive_summary.strengths: Clearly explains matte/soft-touch, foil stamping, embossing/debossing and UV coatings, with holiday-specific applications and relevant product links.
executive_summary.critical_findings: The fifth numbered option is structural/interior design rather than a finishing process, the article omits ordering trade-offs and uses unsupported superlatives and subjective performance claims.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Separate structure from finishes; add compatibility, budget/volume, proofing, registration and substrate constraints; replace unsupported guarantees and edit wording.
